name: Groundwork
pitch: Tap a ring when you do a habit, then work through today's tasks one at a time on a focus timer.
problem: Most habit trackers reset your streak the day you go on a trip.

stats.label: views of every habit: today, month, year
scenes that grow while you focus
layouts, and each device picks its own

features.title: Your year at a glance
features.text: Month and Year views show every check-in, your best runs and how you compare.
details: Check-ins, days you showed up and your longest run
Each habit's year as a grid, month by month
This month so far vs. the same days last month

screen.alt: Groundwork's Year view: 417 check-ins, 107 days showed up, longest run 32, and a grid of check-ins per habit by month

features.title: Tasks on a focus timer
features.text: Give each task a time, then start focus and take them one by one.
details: Do later, +5 min, pause or done, without leaving focus
A seedling, tower or gumball scene grows as you work

screen.alt: Groundwork's Tasks view: 1 of 4 cleared, 10 min focused today, three tasks with times and a Start focus button

features.title: Streaks survive a trip
features.text: Mark days away and your streak carries straight over them.
details: Or log days you did it but forgot to tap
Away days count neither for nor against you

features.title: Yours on every device
features.text: Sign in with Google or GitHub and changes arrive live everywhere.
details: A phone and a desktop can each show a different layout
Back up everything to one file, and import it anywhere
